authorization.production_rules: Local source audit of the NEW v1.6.0 changes only. All live testing runs against an in-process router or the local deployment stack (compose MinIO/Postgres/Redis) on loopback. No external targets, no production instances. Read-only for finder lanes; PoC execution only through the sandboxed bounty validation runner.

evidence: pushed to origin 2026-08-15; all gates green (cargo make ci exit 0, coverage 93.68% >= 93.10%, migration-sync 17 versions, e2e + sdx suites green)

impact_rules.source: Self-hosted S3-compatible + multi-protocol storage server; severity mapping for the v1.6.0 red-team engagement

critical: Forgeable or bypassable authorization capability (unauthorized read/write/delete of any repo-scoped data)
Authentication bypass in the capability extractors (S3/LFS/OCI/Hub/Xet/Bazel)
Fail-loud secret-encryption gate bypass allowing production plaintext secrets
Supply-chain compromise via the release tooling (publish-order generator, publish scripts)
high: Cross-tenant access via capability scope confusion (permissive-mode anonymous capability, extractor seam)
GC data-loss or wedge from the chunk-hash validation change
Migration registration gaps causing silent PG-backed data failures
Request smuggling or path traversal reintroduced by the route-handler migration
medium: Capability contract violations (scope escalation, namespace confusion)
Chaos/drill harness code bugs with safety impact
Resource-exhaustion DoS in the new code paths
low: Hardening gaps, error-envelope details, non-destructive robustness issues

exclusions: The S3 frontend core surface already audited in the earlier S3 hunt (findings F-7..F-11, all fixed), EXCEPT the new v1.6.0 changes to those routes (the capability extractor migration)

accounts.note: LocalHmac-minted bearer tokens for repo scopes (ac.assets / team.cli-*), used by the drill/e2e harnesses; access-key=token for SigV4

known_findings: S3 hunt F-7..F-11 (CopyObject ceiling, conditional TOCTOU, lock-map leak, lock convoy, torn metadata) — all fixed, do NOT re-report
GC abort on chunk temp files (.tmp-*) — fixed (chunk_hash returns Ok(None))
Postgres migration registration gap (s3_object_etag_metadata missing from SHARDLINE_MIGRATIONS) — fixed
Report-only: xorb transfer route serves corrupt bytes without content validation; /v1/reconstructions/{file_id} requires 64-hex file ids

F-12 fail-loud gate (deployment-mode fail-open parse + default-Insecure disarm + Authenticated-without-provider + warning text) — FIXED in this cycle; audit the FIX for new edge cases, do NOT re-report
F-13 GC stale-temp reaper (stranded .tmp-* files now reaped after 1h) — FIXED; audit the reaper for new edge cases (fresh-temp protection, reaper racing an active write), do NOT re-report
F-14 capability seal (from_verified_context / AuthContext::new are public, convention-enforced) — documented; a type-level seal is a follow-up, do NOT re-report
